name: io.github.123mason123/perpspread-mcp
title: PerpSpread — Cross-Exchange Perpetual Funding Arbitrage MCP
description: Live 7-venue crypto funding rate spreads, L2 slippage audits, and rotation math.

tools.name: get_top_funding_spreads
tools.description: Scan live cross-exchange perpetual funding rate arbitrage spreads across 7 venues (OKX, Binance, Bybit, Bitget, Gate, Hyperliquid, Aster).

min_volume_usd.description: Minimum 24h volume USD across both legs (default 1000000).

exchange.description: Optional exchange filter: okx, binance, bybit, bitget, gate, hyperliquid, aster.

limit.description: Number of top spreads to return (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: get_symbol_funding_breakdown
tools.description: Get all 7-venue live funding rates, settlement intervals, mark prices, and 7D/30D realized funding APR for a specific coin.

symbol.description: Coin ticker such as BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, DOGE.

tools.name: audit_orderbook_slippage
tools.description: Fetch live Top-20 L2 orderbooks across the optimal long and short venues for a symbol to inspect real bid/ask depth and slippage.

symbol.description: Coin ticker such as BTC, ETH, SOL.

tools.name: calculate_rotation_breakeven
tools.description: Evaluate whether rotating from an existing funding-arb pair A into target symbol B pays back 4-leg fees, slippage, and exit/entry basis.

target_symbol.description: Target coin ticker to rotate into.

okx_rebate.description: Apply optional OKX 20% new-user fee rebate (default false; Standard VIP 0 baseline).

tools.name: get_cash_and_carry_spreads
tools.description: Get live Spot-Long / Perp-Short positive funding cash-and-carry opportunities across CEX venues.

limit.description: Number of top opportunities to return (1-30, default 10).
